mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 5.0%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession fears mount.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 1.5% year-over-year, the economy is in an expansion phase, which typically supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits rise.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% y/y, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 3.0% y/y, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%), the labor market is tight, which typically supports strong consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.0%, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 95.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) above 800,000 units signals strong consumer confidence and demand for durable goods, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 800,000 units, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.
